hernandez.title: Hernandez exterior
hernandez.src: PaintScout #4127 · sold Oct 16 by Dana R.
hernandez.writeup: Hernandez residence, Pinecrest. [ext|Two-story CBS/stucco home], [lead|built 1974]. Scope: [prep|pressure wash, patch stucco cracks at NE corner, prime patches]; [spray|two coats elastomeric on body] (Loxon XP, Repose Gray); trim and fascia in Pure White; front door Tricorn Black. Second-story eaves need a 28 ft ladder or lift. Colors HOA-approved Oct 16; [hoa|HOA allows work Mon to Fri, 8am to 5pm only]. [lang|Mrs. Hernandez prefers updates in Spanish]. [due|Hosting a wedding Nov 14, wants everything done by Nov 12]. [hours|Est. 120 labor hours]. [vip|Returning client (2019 interior), has referred 5 jobs].

okafor.title: Okafor trim & door
okafor.src: PaintScout #4133 · sold Oct 20 by Dana R.
okafor.writeup: Okafor residence, Pinecrest. [ext|Exterior trim, fascia and front door only]. Built 1988. [cutin|Crisp cut lines at the stucco], [color|door in Urbane Bronze]. [hours|Est. 18 labor hours, one day]. Flexible on dates, [due|any day before Nov 2].

patel.src: PaintScout #4140 · sold Oct 21 by Luis P.
patel.writeup: Patel residence, Kendall. [cab|Kitchen cabinets: 24 doors, 9 drawer fronts, boxes]. [spray|Spray finish], doors sprayed off-site. [color|Fine finish, client is particular about color]. [hours|Est. 40 labor hours]. [due|Before Nov 6].

gutierrez.title: Gutierrez interior
gutierrez.src: PaintScout #4142 · sold Oct 22 by Dana R.
gutierrez.writeup: Gutierrez residence, Coral Gables. [int|Interior: living, dining, two bedrooms]. [lead|Built 1955, original plaster]. [drywall|Plaster crack repair in dining room]. [cutin|Clean cut lines at the crown]. [hours|Est. 48 labor hours]. [lang|Ms. Gutierrez prefers Haitian Creole]. [due|Before Nov 6].

Balanced.d: Job fit first, then quality, reliability and start date.

Protect margin.d: Crews that finish within the sold days at a good cost.

Fastest start.d: Whoever can start soonest and show up.

White glove.d: Best quality and client manner. Default for important clients.

learned.text: Schedulers pick Gian for exteriors worth $12,000 or more, even when another crew can start sooner.
Tania’s crew of 6 goes on commercial and HOA jobs first because they finish big jobs fastest.
Johan & Dani get passed over for interiors with plaster or drywall repair.
